authority: User-confirmed goals and source constraints plus explicit designer-selected interaction defaults. This is not runtime verification or installation/publication authorization.

screens.name: Connect workspace
screens.purpose: Private access, explicit account/scope selection and separate provider/writer readiness.

screens.name: Study home
screens.purpose: All configured courses, continue cards and honest preparation coverage; no marketing landing page.

screens.name: Course lecture list
screens.purpose: All lecture units and sessions, source availability and processing state without conflating preparation with learning.

screens.name: Lecture workspace
screens.purpose: Large versioned slide, collapsible thumbnails, persistent player, Tutor/Transcript/Sources context panel.

screens.name: Source detail
screens.purpose: Resolve a permitted versioned page/time/figure anchor; preserve origin and support explicit return.

screens.name: Question and practice
screens.purpose: Complete prompt/figures, reference conditions, response editor, hints and feedback; never an isolated text-only paraphrase of a diagram problem.

screens.name: Questions and review
screens.purpose: Due, selected, available questions and suggestions; active scheduling is distinct from simply saving an item.

screens.name: Review session
screens.purpose: One item at a time, actual response, review feedback and optional detour; no fictional reviews on skip.

screens.name: Progress and learning gaps
screens.purpose: Observed skill evidence, assistance, freshness and priority; no invented universal mastery score.

screens.name: Concept detail
screens.purpose: Typed concept/skill/question relationships and source/attempt references; tree is a projection.

screens.name: Study history
screens.purpose: Exact submitted questions/responses, delivered replies and assessment revisions, not hidden model reasoning.

screens.name: Activity and request detail
screens.purpose: Separate local capture, transport, native turn, answer, canonical save and view states with relevant actions.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Appearance, access, data, notifications and operator controls. No credentials displayed or permissions granted from arbitrary task content.

screens.name: Conflict resolution
screens.purpose: Preserve both versions and resolve deliberate edits without last-write-wins for evidence.

screens.name: Repair preview
screens.purpose: Explicit bounded repair scope and verified outcome; no autonomous lock deletion or history recreation.

screens.name: Session wrap-up
screens.purpose: Where the user stopped, actual work, pending saves and optional next actions; no automatic calendar changes.

screens.name: Search
screens.purpose: Scope to current course by default; source, lecture, question and concept results retain types, versions and access.

screens.name: Response capture
screens.purpose: Typed text, recording controls, transcript correction and attachment review. No audio upload before applicable permission.

flows.title: Connect the private workspace
flows.trigger: First visit, explicit Add connection, or a missing required grant.
preconditions: Single learner; no public signup, payment, team invitation or archive migration.
Use the supported, separately authorized account flow; no copied tokens.

steps.visible_response: See what data will be read, which approved writes may later occur and what stays outside scope.

steps.user_action: Choose the correct account and course folder bindings
steps.visible_response: Course IDs and terms are reconciled with existing configuration; same-name snapshots are not selected by guess.

steps.user_action: Review requested access and confirm the supported authorization
steps.visible_response: Drive read, input submission, native route and writer status appear as separate checks.
Available original sources can be browsed even when AI execution is not verified.

steps.user_action: Open Setup details when a required capability is blocked
steps.visible_response: See the precise next action without an instruction to weaken permissions.

alternative_and_failure_paths: Denied or cancelled access returns to connection review without deleting existing records.
A missing native bridge shows Native connection not verified; it is not labeled Connected because the PC is on.
A mismatched term/course/root stops activation for that binding only.
read_dependencies: Course configuration and source identities
Authorized capability/readiness receipts
writes_and_owner: Connection/preference metadata: app configuration owner, no secret values in course Markdown
No attempt, grade, catalog or publisher installation is created
completion: The selected private sources resolve or their exact access gap is visible.
No test run or live writer activation is inferred from accepting a screen.
responsive_and_accessibility_notes: Keyboard-first form, password-manager-compatible supported authorization, explanatory errors.
Mobile uses the same scoped steps rather than a desktop G: path.

writes_and_owner: Device connection/preference owner
Draft export or cancellation only from the explicit selected action
completion: The new device can verify permitted content or reports its limitation.
